_comment: Browser-only shelf labels. This is NOT the taxonomy in catalog/taxonomy.json
and must never be merged into it. That one ships inside published kit
submodules, so it stays conservative and vendor-neutral; this one exists to
make a dropdown useful and can be wrong at the cost of one confused click.
Matching is by whole token, never by substring. Substrings are what made
'arch' match Architecture and 'bat' match Battery_Room. Names are split on
punctuation, on camelCase, and between letters and digits, so Backyard_Chair,
BackyardChair01 and BACKYARD_CHAIR all yield the token 'chair'. Trailing 's'
Shelves are tags, not a tree: an asset may sit on several. That is
deliberate. An exclusive tree needs a priority order, and getting that order
wrong is what silently emptied a whole kit's floor category once already.
Covers roughly 73% of assets the index calls 'other'. The rest are genuine
one-offs -- an ammeter, a fire extinguisher -- and 'Uncategorised' says so
honestly rather than inventing a shelf for them.
